title: Strategy push: turn a rough idea into a stronger one
prompt: Rough idea: add a 'sync everything' button to the mobile app. Thoughts?
trap: accept the idea as-is without pushing for a bigger or sharper version
expected_behaviors: returns a stronger version of the idea
flags a tradeoff or scope risk
pass_criteria: Improves the idea and pushes toward the real goal rather than rubber-stamping it.
